title: Carson and Ross join the panel
summary: Season 7 replaced Santino Rice on the regular panel with Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews, who shared judging duties and were both present for the premiere (US-S07-E01).

title: Trixie Mattel returns via Conjoined Queens
summary: After elimination in Spoof! (There It Is) (US-S07-E04), Trixie Mattel re-entered when Pearl won the Conjoined Queens makeover (US-S07-E08). She was eliminated again in Prancing Queens (US-S07-E10).

title: Four-way Born Naked lip-sync
summary: In And the Rest Is Drag (US-S07-E12), the final four lip-synced to RuPaul's "Born Naked." Kennedy Davenport was eliminated; Ginger Minj, Pearl, and Violet Chachki advanced to the finale.

title: Violet Chachki wins Season 7
summary: At the Grand Finale (US-S07-E14), Violet Chachki was crowned. Ginger Minj and Pearl were runners-up. Katya was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers. The cash prize was $100,000.
